body.x: iHealth(www.ihealthlabs.com) unveiled 'Wireless Blood Pressure Monitor' at '2014 International CES', the biggest ITappliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
With no plugs or connections to manage, the Wireless Blood Pressure Monitor is a device to check blood pressure, using the free iHealth mobile app via bluetooth.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
